tactics: intro _ _ f l acc <;> induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [List.filterMapM.loop, *]
intro inst _ f l acc <;> induction l generalizing acc with | nil => simp [List.filterMapM.loop] | cons a as ih => simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]; congr; funext x; cases x <;> simp [ih]
intro _ _ f l <;> induction l <;> intro acc <;> simp_all [List.filterMapM.loop]
